notes.title: Wednesday Reminder: BETA VERSION ON STEAM!
notes.notes:
[b]Beta[/b] version available [b]on Steam[/b]!

Anyone can become a beta tester and give her own contribution to the project.

Ask us a Steam key to download and play the game on PC Windows and MAC (with Oculus / HTC VR support).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270734/6a7f92d0735c7e12c3c3692f62e59c48da978c39.png[/img]

notes.title: OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
Finally! The official release date of [b]PROGETTO USTICA[/b] is August 29th, 2018.
The game will be downloadable for free from Steam and will be playable on PC Windows and MAC (with Oculus / HTC VR support).

[b]PROGETTO USTICA BETA VERSION[/b] is available on Steam!
Ask us a Steam key to start playing the game now.
Your help in this is very important!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270734/cb90a33057d40a51f78cf8c38fed7c9f0b8b361c.png[/img]
